== Summary ==
Jason Markley, a cool guy who qualified for Star Wars CCG World Finals at Wizard World, hails from Normal, IL. Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999]], [[1999 Decipher World Championship]], [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]], [[Jason Markley]].
